milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The soul_sand patch is centered around (-7, -1, 6) spawn-relative. The player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they found it. max_distance=10 ensures the player actually walks toward the soul_sand area rather than triggering from spawn (which is ~9 blocks away from center). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the soul_sand.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The taiga-like area is represented by podzol ground, spruce trees, and ferns centered around (9, 0, 7) spawn-relative. The player must navigate near it and face toward it. max_distance=10 ensures the player walks close enough to clearly identify the taiga characteristics (podzol, spruce logs, ferns). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the biome area.

Uses inventory_has because mining a jungle_log block drops a jungle_log item that ends up in the player's inventory. The player has an iron_axe and jungle logs are placed at (10, 0-2, 4) and (8, 0-1, 9) within the taiga zone. When mined, the block drops as an item that the player picks up automatically.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_trapdoor results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The full crafting chain is: mine dark_oak_logs (at -7/0-2/6, -5/0-2/6, -8/0-2/8) → craft to dark_oak_planks (1 log = 4 planks) → craft dark_oak_trapdoor at crafting table (-6, 0, 6) using 6 planks in 2x3 pattern. There are 9 dark_oak_logs available, far more than the 2 minimum needed.
